text: dsh-api3d 是 DSH Web 端的 API3D 模型路由插件。它注册 OpenAI 兼容的 API3D provider，并通过侧边栏向导查询、选择和导入账号可用模型。设置页可配置站点地址、API Key 引用和出站兼容选项；模型导入后即可在 DSH 模型选择器中使用。模型请求发送至配置的 API3D 服务，需要 API3D API Key。

dsh-api3d connects API3D as a DSH Web model route. Its sidebar wizard queries the API3D catalog, lets users select models, and imports them into DSH. Configure the site address and API key reference in the settings page; imported models appear in the model selector. Requires an API3D key.

dsh-api3d 的功能「模型目录导入」：侧边栏向导使用 API Key 查询站点模型，用户勾选模型并将目录导入 DSH。
dsh-api3d 的功能「API3D 模型路由」：将已导入的模型注册为 OpenAI 兼容 provider 路由，模型请求发往设置的站点基础地址。
dsh-api3d 使用前须知：需要 API3D_API_KEY 凭据引用；模型查询与模型请求会连接 API3D 或配置的站点地址。（见 lib/site.js:40-47、lib/route.js:35-39）

dsh-api3d README · dsh-api3d：这是一个**骨架**：核心链路（路由存活 + 出站围栏 + 凭据写入 + 设置卡 + 密钥/模型向导）
已经完整可跑，余额 / 用量 / 计费 / 健康探测四项留了明确的接缝，等着填。

装好后侧边栏「插件」下面会多一行 **API3D**：点进去填一次密钥、勾选站点上的模型，
就能直接用。详见「密钥与模型向导」。

dsh-api3d README · 设计取舍：- **不自研 `LlmAdapter`。** 自研一个 provider 适配器意味着复刻 harness ↔ pi-ai 的整个
  转换层（官方那个约 1000 行：Context 组装、StreamChunk 翻译、replay 状态、
  上下文溢出判定）。单站场景不值这个价。所以路由仍然**由官方适配器执行**，只是不写死在
  补丁层里：宿主半在解析期把一条 `llm-pi-ai.providers.api3d` 装进正在运行的配置。
- **不声明「空路由」。** pi-ai 拒绝一条解析不出任何模型的自定义路由（配置校验会报
  *resolves no models; the installed catalog does not describe this route*）。
  所以**没导入任何模型时，本插件一条 provider 都不声明**：设置里不会多出 API3D 条目，
  模型选择器里也没有 API3D 分组。向导导入之后路由才出现，选择器立刻跟上，不用重启。
- **运行时装配有两个坑，插件就是为它们存在的**（见下）。

dsh-api3d README · 坑一：profile 补丁层会把整条路由挤掉：profile 自己的 `llm-pi-ai.providers` 补丁在**每个 bundle 层之后**应用，而 loader 的
合并是「一层深」的：补丁里的 `config` 是**赋值**而不是深合并，所以整个 `providers`
字典会被替换。任何自带 provider 的 profile（随包发行的 `desktop` profile 就是）
都会丢掉本插件声明的路由。

装路由的时机就挂在解析期：`ctx.on('internal/config', …, { global: true })` 里把带着
**导入目录**的路由补回去，再通过 `ctx.get('loader')` 找到 `llm-pi-ai` 条目、
`entry.update({ config })` 写回（启动时也会试写一次）。没有导入目录时这一步整个跳过 ——
既不装路由，也不去动别人同名的那条。

> 为什么不能只写一次：宿主 profile 的 watcher 会在启动后几秒重读补丁文件，
> 把一次性写入回滚。必须每次解析都补。

dsh-api3d README · 坑一：profile 补丁层会把整条路由挤掉：补回去的时候用的是**「本插件自己那条说了算」**的写法（`replace`）：解析出的 `providers`
里已经有 `api3d` 时，只要它与要写的路由完全一致就跳过（值没变就不写，免得自己触发自己
的解析风暴），否则整条替换。这里有个很容易踩的坑：`internal/config` 监听器的**第一个参数
是宿主解析出来的 `llm-pi-ai` 配置，不是本插件的设置** —— 两者曾经同名，结果每次解析都拿
模板里的默认目录把导入的那份盖回去，表现就是「模型导入了，但选择器里永远只有一条」。
现在两个参数名分开写，要装的路由一律由插件设置算出（`routeValue`），不再因为
「同名路由已存在」而提前返回。

服务器好）。

dsh-api3d README · 坑二：baseURL 由适配器逐请求解析，但它读不到本插件的设置：| 出站兼容 | 为什么需要 |
| --- | --- |
| 改写 baseURL | 见上 |
| 可选替换 `User-Agent` | 有些站点按 UA 认证，而适配器会剥掉与它归属头冲突的 profile header |
| 可选直连（绕过进程代理） | 站点 WAF 常把数据中心出口 IP 判成挑战，回 200 HTML 而不是 SSE |
| 可选补 `required: []` | 站点转发到严格上游时，缺 `required` 的工具 schema 会被拒 |
| 可选静默重试 | 站点多通道转发，个别通道把本可重试的请求判成 400 |
| 402 额度错误加提示 | 站点用 402 + 被错标成 `text/event-stream` 的 JSON 报额度耗尽 |

dsh-api3d README · 安装与分发：装完**重启 DSH**：插件行是 boot graph 的一部分，热载不生效。

三个实测事实（在干净隔离实例上走真实安装路径验过两遍：一次是 `npm pack` 产出的
tarball，一次是 npm 渠道的 `add dsh-api3d`；两次的启动日志都打出
`api3d: 路由 api3d → …`）：

dsh-api3d README · 安装与分发：1. `add` 会自动把 `dsh-api3d` 追加进该 profile `package.json` 的
   `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手工编辑；`dependencies` 一并写入。
2. 装好的包是 `profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-api3d` 下的**真实目录**，而且
   **它自己不需要 `node_modules`**：宿主半的 `import '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'`
   由 profile 内的解析层路由到应用自带的那一份。只有本地开发（插件在 profiles 目录
   之外）才需要自己软链宿主依赖，见「开发」。
3. 浏览器半同样被认出来：实例返回的 HTML 里模块清单含 `dsh-api3d`
   （`url: plugins/??dsh-api3d/client.js&rev=…`，带 `inject` 列表）。刚装好、还没导入
   模型时启动日志打出的是 `api3d: 尚未导入模型 → 暂不声明 api3d 路由`，导入之后变成
   `api3d: 路由 api3d → https://api3d.cn/v1，模型目录 N 个（从站点导入）：…`。

dsh-api3d README · 安装与分发：关于**版本兼容闸门**：插件管理器会检查 `peerDependencies` 里以 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`
开头的条目是否满足当前 DSH 版本，不满足就拒绝安装（除非在 profile 的
`compatibility.json` 里按精确版本开豁免）。本包只声明
`@deepseek-ai/cordis` / `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，不在闸门范围内，所以不会卡住安装；
代价是本包**不做运行时版本自检** —— DSH 大版本升级后如果插件报错，请开 issue。

> **安全提醒**：本包的宿主半在 DSH 进程内运行，**不受工作区沙箱限制**，并且会拿到
> API Key。装之前请读 `lib/index.js`。

dsh-api3d README · 密钥与模型向导：装好后**不用先记字段**：侧边栏「插件」下面会多一行 **API3D**，点进去就是向导
（面板第一次打开、且还没导入模型时会自动弹出）：

1. 填站点密钥（基础地址已预填 `https://api3d.cn/v1`），点「确认并查询模型」。
   还没有密钥的话，输入框下方有一条「还没有 API Key？前往 api3d.cn 获取」，
   点它在系统浏览器里打开站点注册页（宿主按外链处理，不会在应用内嵌窗口里跑）。
2. 宿主半拿这把 key 去 `GET {baseURL}/models`，把站点实际在售的模型列出来。
3. 勾选要用的模型，点「导入所选模型」。

dsh-api3d README · 密钥与模型向导：密钥框不会把整串藏起来：失焦时显示成 `api3d-…cdef`（首尾可见、中段打码），点进输入框
才显示完整值。填过一次之后，框右侧的下拉按钮会列出**最近用过的 5 把密钥**（最新的在最前，
列表里同样只显示打码形式），选一条就能直接用它去查询，不用重新粘贴；旁边的「清空历史」
把它删掉。历史记在 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `<apiKeyEnv>_HISTORY`
（默认 `API3D_API_KEY_HISTORY`）里，与密钥本身同处一个文件。

**下拉里的密钥是宿主代取的。** DSH 的凭据服务是单向的：`describe` 只回答「某个引用名配没配」，
没有任何读路径会把值交给页面（这也是 DSH 的既定设计）。所以这条列表由宿主半从凭据库读出、
只把 `api3d-…cdef` 这样的**打码标签**发给浏览器；选中时浏览器只回一个序号
（`POST /api/api3d.keys` 拿清单、`keyIndex` 随查询/导入请求回传），真实值全程不出宿主进程。
「清除历史」也只是让宿主 `unset` 那条派生引用。

dsh-api3d README · 密钥与模型向导：**第 2 步列出的不只是名字。** 每行都带一条能力摘要（形如
`输入 文本 · 上下文 1,000,000 · 最大输出 384,000 · 5 档推理`），行尾的「调整能力」可以
逐条展开修改：

| 控件 | 落到路由描述符的字段 | 初值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 输入：文本 / 图像 | `input` | 只勾「文本」 |
| 上下文 | `contextWindow` | 能力模板的初值（1,000,000） |
| 最大输出 | `maxTokens` | 同上（384,000） |
| 推理档位：关闭 / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `reasoningEfforts` | 能力模板那 6 档（`off` = 提供 Off 但不发该字段） |

每行的能力**互相独立**：改一行不影响其它行，也不改能力模板（`lib/route.js` 的
`MODEL_TEMPLATE`）。数字留空表示「用模板里的值」。

dsh-api3d README · 密钥与模型向导：要注意的是：`api3d.cn` 的 `/v1/models` 只回 `id` 与 `display_name`，不报输入模态、上下文
窗口或推理档位，所以这里的初值是本插件的内置默认，**不是站点声明的值**。勾「图像」或加档位
之前先确认站点真的支持，否则请求会被上游拒绝。合法词汇表由 DSH 的 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 适配器
定义：模态只有 `text` / `image`，档位只有 `off` / `minimal` / `low` / `medium` / `high` /
`xhigh` / `max`；勾成别的会在执行时被适配器拒掉。站点**真报了的**能力字段（`input` /
`input_modalities` / `context_window` / `max_input_tokens` / `limit.context` /
`max_output_tokens` / `top_provider.max_completion_tokens` 等常见写法）会被直接采用，
站点没报的才回落默认 —— 「没说」与「说了不支持」是两件事，不会互相冒充。

dsh-api3d README · 密钥与模型向导：导入时做三件事：密钥写进 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`、勾选的目录（连同各自的能力）写进
本插件设置 `models`、再由宿主把目录装成 `llm-pi-ai` 路由。模型选择器立刻能看到它们，
不用重启 —— 第一次导入之前，设置与选择器里都没有 API3D 这一项。

`/api/api3d.apply` 把目录放在**请求体**里（而不是回头去读插件设置），所以即使那一刻设置
还没重新解析，装回去的也一定是刚勾选的那份；解析期钩子随后会用设置里的同一份目录覆盖
任何同名的 `api3d` 路由（本插件自己那条说了算）。

补丁层里**完全没有** `- id: llm-pi-ai` 条目也能导入：条目缺失、或它的形态不是键值对时，
宿主半把它当作一份空配置，从零建出 `providers.api3d` 写回去 —— 不会再出现「配置不可合并」
这类拒绝。（0.2.5 之前这里会报错，等于要求用户先手写一条 `llm-pi-ai` 声明才用得了向导。）

头，浏览器直接请求会被跨域预检挡成 403。向导背后的两条宿主路由是：

| 路由 | 方法 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/api3d.models` | POST `{apiKey, baseURL?}` | 宿主侧查站点模型目录，返回归一后的目录（站点真报了的输入模态/上下文/最大输出/推理档位一并带上）与一组 `defaults`（向导每行的初值） |
| `/api/api3d.apply` | POST `{models?}` | 把请求体里的目录（缺省则用设置里已导入的那份）装回 `llm-pi-ai` 路由；补丁层没有 `llm-pi-ai` 条目时也会从零建出并写入 |

两条都注册在 `connection.fetch` 的精确路由表上，所以自动带 DSH 的 Host/Origin
围栏与浏览器会话鉴权；未授权的请求到不了处理函数。

dsh-api3d README · Design tradeoffs：In one sentence: **the protocol, the model catalog and the reasoning tiers are
configuration, not code; the plugin exists only to make the relay actually accept the
request.**

dsh-api3d README · Design tradeoffs：- **No custom `LlmAdapter`.** Writing a provider adapter means reimplementing the whole
  harness ↔ pi-ai translation layer (the official one is ~1000 lines: context assembly,
  StreamChunk translation, replay state, context-overflow detection). Not worth it for a
  single site. So the route is still **executed by the official adapter** — it is simply not
  hard-coded in the patch layer: the host half installs one `llm-pi-ai.providers.api3d` into
  the config that is being resolved.
- **No "empty route" declaration.** pi-ai rejects a custom route that resolves to no models
  at all (validation reports *resolves no models; the installed catalog does not describe
  this route*). So **while nothing has been imported, this plugin declares no provider at
  all**: no API3D entry appears under Settings → Models, and no API3D group appears in the
  model picker. The route shows up once the wizard imports a catalog, and the picker follows
  immediately — no restart.
- **Runtime assembly has two traps, and this plugin exists for them** (below).

dsh-api3d README · Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route：A profile's own `llm-pi-ai.providers` patch is applied **after every bundle layer**, and the
loader merges one level deep: the patch's `config` is an **assignment**, not a deep merge,
so the entire `providers` dictionary is replaced. Any profile that ships its own provider
(the `desktop` profile that DSH itself distributes does) loses the route this plugin
declares.
section: Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route

text:
dsh-api3d README · Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route：The host half cannot observe when that happens, so it hooks the resolution:
`ctx.on('internal/config', …, { global: true })` puts the route carrying the **imported
catalog** back, then `ctx.get('loader')` finds the `llm-pi-ai` entry and
`entry.update({ config })` writes it home (there is also one attempt at startup). With no
imported catalog that whole step is skipped — no route is installed and nobody else's
same-name route is touched.
section: Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route

text:
dsh-api3d README · Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route：> Why not write it once: the host profile's watcher re-reads the patch file seconds after
> startup and rolls a one-shot write back. It has to be re-applied on every resolution.
section: Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route

text:
dsh-api3d README · Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route：When it puts the route back it uses **"this plugin's own declaration wins"** semantics
(`replace`): if the resolved `providers` already contains `api3d`, the hook skips the write
when the value is identical (no needless write, which would otherwise trigger a resolution
storm of its own) and replaces the whole route otherwise. There is an easy trap here: the
**first argument of an `internal/config` listener is the host's resolved `llm-pi-ai` config,
not this plugin's settings** — the two were once named the same, so every resolution stamped
the template's default catalog back over the imported one, which showed up as "the models are
imported but the selector only ever offers one". The parameter names are now distinct, the
route to install is always computed from the plugin's settings (`routeValue`), and the claim
path no longer returns early just because a same-name route already exists.
section: Trap 1: the profile patch layer replaces the whole route

text:
dsh-api3d README · Trap 2: baseURL is resolved per request, but the adapter cannot see this plugin's settings：Two namespaces. So the route's `baseURL` points at a host that deliberately does not exist
(`upstream.api3d.invalid`, an RFC 2606 reserved TLD), and the fence rewrites it to the real
address from settings on the way out.
section: Trap 2: baseURL is resolved per request, but the adapter cannot see this plugin's settings

text:
dsh-api3d README · Trap 2: baseURL is resolved per request, but the adapter cannot see this plugin's settings：The upside of that detour is that "switch data centre" becomes one write on the settings
card. The downside is that **the fence must be on the request path** for every real
endpoint — otherwise DNS fails loudly (deliberately loud: much better than silently
hitting some real server).

The fence also carries the outbound compatibility a relay usually needs:
section: Trap 2: baseURL is resolved per request, but the adapter cannot see this plugin's settings

text:
dsh-api3d README · Trap 2: baseURL is resolved per request, but the adapter cannot see this plugin's settings：| Outbound compatibility | Why it is needed |
| --- | --- |
| rewrite baseURL | see above |
| optional `User-Agent` replacement | some sites authenticate by UA, while the adapter strips profile headers that conflict with its own attribution header |
| optional direct connection (bypass the process proxy) | site WAFs commonly challenge data-centre egress IPs and answer with 200 HTML instead of SSE |
| optional `required: []` fill-in | when the site forwards to a strict upstream, tool schemas without `required` are rejected |
| optional silent retry | relays forward across multiple channels, and some channels turn a retryable request into a 400 |
| 402 quota hint | sites report exhausted quota with 402 plus a JSON body mislabelled `text/event-stream` |

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：The key field never hides the whole value: while it is not focused it reads `api3d-…cdef`
(first and last characters visible, the middle masked), and focusing it shows the full string.
Once you have used a key, the dropdown button on the right lists the **last five keys** (newest
first, also masked) — pick one and it is used for the query directly, with no need to paste it
again; the adjacent **清空历史** ("clear history") action removes them. The history is stored next
to the key itself, in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` under `<apiKeyEnv>_HISTORY` (by default
`API3D_API_KEY_HISTORY`).

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：**The dropdown is served by the host.** DSH's credential service is one-way: `describe` only
answers whether a given reference is configured, and no read path ever hands a value to the page
(that is deliberate in DSH). So the host half reads the list out of the credential store and sends
only masked labels such as `api3d-…cdef` to the browser; picking one sends back just an index
(`POST /api/api3d.keys` returns the list, and a `keyIndex` travels with the query/import requests).
The plaintext value never leaves the host process. **Clear history** is likewise just the host
calling `unset` on that derived reference.

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：**Step 2 lists more than names.** Every row carries a capability summary (shaped like
`输入 文本 · 上下文 1,000,000 · 最大输出 384,000 · 5 档推理`), and the **调整能力** ("adjust
capabilities") button at the end of the row expands a per-model editor:

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：| Control | Field it writes into the route descriptor | Initial value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Input: 文本 / 图像 (text / image) | `input` | `text` only |
| Context (上下文) | `contextWindow` | the capability template's value (1,000,000) |
| Max output (最大输出) | `maxTokens` | same source (384,000) |
| Reasoning levels: 关闭 / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `reasoningEfforts` | the capability template's six levels (`off` = offer Off but send nothing) |

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：Capabilities are **per row**: editing one row leaves the others alone and never mutates the
capability template (`MODEL_TEMPLATE` in `lib/route.js`). Leaving a number box empty means
"use the template's value".

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：One caveat matters here: `api3d.cn`'s `/v1/models` returns only `id` and `display_name` — no
input modalities, no context window, no reasoning levels. So the initial values come from
this plugin's capability template (`MODEL_TEMPLATE`), **not from anything the site declared**. Confirm the site
really supports image input or an extra level before ticking it, or the upstream will reject
the request. The legal vocabulary is defined by DSH's `dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter: modalities are
only `text` / `image`, levels are only `off` / `minimal` / `low` / `medium` / `high` /
`xhigh` / `max`, and anything else is rejected at execution time. Capability fields the site
**does** report (`input`, `input_modalities`, `context_window`, `max_input_tokens`,
`limit.context`, `max_output_tokens`, `top_provider.max_completion_tokens`, and similar
spellings) are adopted as-is; only what the site stays silent about falls back to the
defaults — "did not say" and "said it does not support" are different things and never
impersonate each other.

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：Import does three things: writes the key into `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, writes the
ticked catalog (each entry with its own capabilities) into this plugin's `models` setting,
and has the host install that catalog as the `llm-pi-ai` route. The model picker sees them
immediately, with no restart — before the first import neither Settings → Models nor the
picker has an API3D entry at all.

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：`/api/api3d.apply` takes the catalog in its **request body** instead of re-reading the plugin
setting, so even if that setting has not been re-resolved yet, what gets installed is exactly
what was just ticked; the resolution-time hook then overwrites any same-name `api3d` route
with the same catalog from settings (this plugin's own version wins).

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：Import also works when the patch layer has **no** `- id: llm-pi-ai` entry at all: when the entry
is missing, or its shape is not a mapping, the host half treats it as an empty base and builds
`providers.api3d` from scratch — no more "configuration cannot be merged" style refusals.
(Before 0.2.5 this was rejected, which effectively required users to hand-write an `llm-pi-ai`
declaration before the wizard was usable.)

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：Why the query goes through the host: `api3d.cn`'s `/v1/models` returns no
`access-control-*` headers at all, so a direct browser request is blocked by the
cross-origin preflight with a 403. The two host routes behind the wizard are:

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/api3d.models` | POST `{apiKey, baseURL?}` | query the site's model catalog host-side; returns the normalized catalog (including any input modalities / context / max output / reasoning levels the site really reports) plus a set of `defaults` (the seed for each wizard row) |
| `/api/api3d.apply` | POST `{models?}` | install the catalog from the request body (or, when absent, the one already stored in settings) back into the `llm-pi-ai` route; builds that entry from scratch when the patch layer has none |

dsh-api3d README · Key and model wizard：Both are registered on `connection.fetch`'s exact-route table, so they automatically carry
DSH's Host/Origin fence and browser session authentication; unauthorized requests never
reach the handlers.
